title: Normalized reduced integral fraction
statement:
Fix an indeterminate $T$, and let
$Z(T)\in1+T\mathbf Z[[T]]\cap\mathbf Q(T)$ be any rational series
with integer coefficients and constant coefficient one, in the
formal power series convention.
A normalized reduced integral presentation
of $Z$ is a pair $A,B\in\mathbf Z[T]$ such that

$$
A(0)=B(0)=1,
\qquad
\gcd(A,B)=1\text{ in }\mathbf Q[T],
\qquad
Z(T)=\frac{A(T)}{B(T)}
$$

as a Taylor series at $T=0$.

Here $\mathbf Z[T]$ and $\mathbf Z[[T]]$ are the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring] and the formal power series ring [def-weil-formal-power-series]; $\mathbf Z[T]\subset\mathbf Q[T]$ and $\mathbf Z[[T]]\subset\mathbf Q[[T]]$ are the coefficientwise maps along $\mathbf Z\subset\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-coefficientwise-ring-hom-map]; $Z\in\mathbf Q(T)$ means that $Z$, regarded in $\mathbf Q[[T]]$, is a rational power series over $\mathbf Q$ [def-weil-rational-power-series]; $A(0),B(0)$ are constant coefficients; $\gcd(A,B)=1$ in $\mathbf Q[T]$ means that the images of $A$ and $B$ in $\mathbf Q[T]$ are coprime [def-weil-coprime-polynomials]; and $Z(T)=A(T)/B(T)$ as a Taylor series at $T=0$ means $BZ=A$ in $\mathbf Z[[T]]$, with $A,B$ regarded as power series [def-weil-polynomial-as-power-series] (equivalently $Z=AB^{-1}$, $B$ being a unit of $\mathbf Z[[T]]$ since $B(0)=1$). The definition is the predicate on the pair $(A,B)$; that such a pair exists and is unique for every $Z\in1+T\mathbf Z[[T]]$ rational over $\mathbf Q$ is the separate statement [prop-weil-integral-rational-series].

split_report.summary: Lean state none on both branches; slopmaster2 blueprint has no copy of this node. Checked the statement against the master blueprint: correct; kept verbatim and added a paragraph naming each notion it uses. stmt_deps were only def-weil-formal-power-series; now polynomial ring, formal power series, rational power series (for Z in Q(T)), and three new Mathlib-leaf definitions: def-weil-coprime-polynomials (IsCoprime / gcd_isUnit_iff), def-weil-coefficientwise-ring-hom-map (Polynomial.map, PowerSeries.map; needed for Z[T]⊂Q[T], Z[[T]]⊂Q[[T]]; the existing def-weil-coefficientwise-extension is only Z[T]→Q_l[T]), def-weil-polynomial-as-power-series (coercion R[X]→R⟦X⟧, for 'Z=A/B as a Taylor series', made precise as BZ=A). The definition contains no claim: it is the predicate on (A,B); existence and uniqueness are prop-weil-integral-rational-series (referenced in the text, not a dependency). Mathlib has no predicate for the whole notion (RatFunc.num/denom normalizes the denominator to be monic over a field), so the node is a definition built from Mathlib leaves.
